The '''Bestine Hospital''' was a [[Medcenter/Legends|medical center]] in [[Bestine (city)/Legends|Bestine]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].

The building was relatively small with a front entrance with a billboard above it inside it contained several [[bacta tank]]s along with a medical professional.
